policyAccounts.description: Accumulation Units Account (AUA) - 100% of each regular premium is used to purchase units and allocated to this account (premium charge 0%, PDF p.5). AUA-only product (single account); the Top-up Units Account only receives excluded recurring-single/top-up premiums. The 5% premium charge applies only to those excluded premiums (PDF p.10). Policy charge and surrender charge are both levied on the AUA / Total Investment Value (PDF p.10-11).

policyAccountFees.description: Policy Charge - Monthly Policy Charge = (2.50% per annum / 12) x Total Investment Value, deducted monthly in advance on each Policy Monthiversary through unit deduction from the AUA (PDF p.10). FLAT 2.50% p.a. (non-escalating, constant base each month). Levied only 'while the policy is in-force during the minimum investment period' (PDF p.10); Plan Description p.1(d) explicitly confirms 'No policy charges after the minimum investment period.' Modeled as a single recurring row for policy years 1-10 (MIP); the charge is 0% from policy year 11 onward, so recurring naturally stops and NO post-MIP row is needed. Continues to be deducted even during non-payment of regular premium.
